description: A React component for visually rendering and exploring JSON data with features like collapsible nodes, search, copy, and markdown preview.

methods.name: detectContentType
methods.description: Detects the type of content (e.g., markdown, json, url, email, code, args, kwargs, string, number, boolean, null) based on the value provided.

methods.name: getTypeIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon component representing the type of content.

methods.name: MarkdownPreview
methods.description: Renders markdown content as formatted HTML with styling.

methods.name: JsonNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a JSON node, supporting expand/collapse, search highlighting, and content previews.

methods.name: UnifiedJsonViewer
methods.description: Main component for rendering and interacting with a JSON data structure, including search, collapse, copy, and header controls.
